candidates.name: Insulin or HOMA-IR to predict breast cancer prognosis and select metformin or lifestyle
candidates.patient_group: Women with early-stage breast cancer, no diabetes
candidates.decision: Prognosis and possible choice of an insulin-lowering adjuvant intervention (metformin, weight loss)
candidates.evidence: C145 prospective cohort n=512, upper insulin quartile had worse distant recurrence and death; C148 cohort n=527, HOMA associated with mortality; C152 cohort n=535, associations time-limited (first 5 years); C153 and C157 small window-of-opportunity metformin studies (insulin fall non-significant in C153; n=11 in C157); C162 population cohort, hyperinsulinaemia and cancer death. Associations only; no test of decision impact.
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 17 covers generic prediction and monitoring, framed around cardiometabolic outcomes; oncology prognosis and metformin selection is a distinct decision and population.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Likely tier D: prognostic association only, attenuated by BMI and over time, no trial showing insulin-guided therapy helps.
candidates.needed: Trial or biomarker-stratified analysis showing insulin-lowering therapy improves outcome in high-insulin patients, plus incremental prognostic value over BMI and stage.

candidates.name: Insulin secretion (INS-30) to choose a weight-loss diet
candidates.patient_group: Adults with overweight or obesity, no diabetes
candidates.evidence: C051 RCT n=609, 12 months: no significant diet by INS-30 interaction (checked by grep in local full text). Negative result.
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records.
candidates.why_not_covered: Treatment-matching decision is not named in any row; row 17 covers prediction and monitoring generally.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Likely tier D: a well-sized RCT found no effect modification, so this is a negative entry.
candidates.needed: Replication showing effect modification; none indicated.

candidates.name: Insulin resistance to select intranasal insulin or insulin-sensitiser therapy in cognitive or mood disorders
candidates.patient_group: Adults with MCI or early Alzheimer disease; adults with unremitted depression
candidates.decision: Predict response to intranasal insulin detemir (C158) or adjuvant pioglitazone (C038)
candidates.evidence: C158 RCT n=60: higher baseline IR predicted greater improvement at 40 IU (r=0.54), post hoc moderator. C038 clinical correlates of pioglitazone response (abstract excerpt only, direction not read).
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 13 is IR-selected pioglitazone after stroke; these are different diseases and drugs.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Likely tier D: small trials, post hoc moderator analyses.
candidates.needed: Pre-specified IR-stratified RCT with replication and a validated threshold.

candidates.name: Baseline insulin or HOMA-IR to predict weight gain on antipsychotics in children
candidates.patient_group: Antipsychotic-naive children and adolescents starting risperidone, olanzapine or quetiapine
candidates.decision: Who needs closer monitoring or an alternative drug
candidates.evidence: C217 cohort n=117, 1 year: higher baseline insulin and HOMA-IR associated with more weight gain. Single cohort.
candidates.guideline_mention: C150, C151, C154 (Canadian SGA guidance, tied to row 50) are in the records; whether they recommend baseline insulin for prediction was not read here.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 50 is fasting insulin as monitoring; baseline insulin as a predictor of future weight gain is a different decision.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Likely tier D: single cohort, association only.
candidates.needed: External validation and evidence that predicted high-risk children benefit from a changed drug or intensified care.

candidates.name: Two-step MODY screening in US youth (antibody-negative, fasting C-peptide at or above 0.8 ng/mL)
candidates.decision: Population screening pathway: antibody-negative plus preserved C-peptide leads to sequencing
candidates.evidence: C201 SEARCH cohort n=586 sequenced, 8.0% had a MODY mutation, most treated with insulin; MODY-positive had lower fasting C-peptide than MODY-negative. C218 UK biomarker plus genetics screening (excerpt only).
candidates.why_not_covered: Mostly covered by rows 7 and 33; listed because the population screening pathway is described.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Probably a refinement of row 7; tier C at most.
candidates.needed: Pathway-level evidence of yield and outcomes in a US population.

candidates.name: Hepatic insulin clearance as a fibrosis marker in chronic liver disease
candidates.measure: OGTT insulin and C-peptide to derive hepatic insulin clearance
candidates.evidence: C161 n=111, clearance correlated with fibrosis (r about -0.23 to -0.27); C144 and C147 are small cirrhosis mechanism studies (n=9 and 11).
candidates.guideline_mention: Not found in the screened records.
candidates.why_not_covered: Row 14 is HOMA-IR in suspected MASLD for comorbidity; clearance derived from insulin and C-peptide kinetics is a different measure and decision.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Likely tier D: weak correlations; non-invasive fibrosis scores exist [recall].
candidates.needed: Diagnostic-accuracy study against elastography or biopsy that beats FIB-4.

candidates.name: Insulin and C-peptide assay standardisation and pre-analytical rules
candidates.measure: Insulin and C-peptide assay harmonisation, stability, analogue cross-reactivity
candidates.decision: Which assay, sample handling and reference limits may be used for any insulin-based decision
candidates.evidence: C009, C015, C019, C045 (eight assays differed up to 1.8-fold in median), C155 (analogue cross-reactivity), C192 (specific assay and the old cut-off), C196, C195, C224 (C-peptide standardisation), C198 and C012 (pre-analytical effects).
candidates.guideline_mention: ADA workgroup reports (C009, C019); not a clinical use.
candidates.why_not_covered: No row addresses assay standardisation as an enabling condition; rows mention it only in path-to-viability text.
candidates.first_pass_viability: Not a use case; infrastructure condition, no tier.
candidates.needed: Common reference material and harmonised results, then assay-specific thresholds.

refinements.missing_piece: Assay-specific insulin cut-offs: with a specific immunoassay the old 36 pmol/L threshold missed 4 of 11 insulinomas at end of fast.
refinements.note: C197 reports performance of the insulin criteria in 237 insulinoma cases and 6% postprandial-only symptoms (relevant to row 23).

refinements.missing_piece: Analogue cross-reactivity data explain why low insulin does not exclude analogue-induced hypoglycaemia.
Free C-peptide after PEG precipitation separates insulin autoimmune syndrome from insulinoma.
SACST interpretation pitfalls from variant arterial anatomy; retrospective n=13 performance.
Paediatric accuracy data: retrospective n=58; only 23 of 28 congenital HI patients had detectable insulin; C-peptide and glucagon response discriminated.
DPT-1 risk score uses OGTT glucose and C-peptide, validated in TrialNet; proposed preclinical-state threshold.
refinements.note: Primary sources for the score behind row 49.

refinements.missing_piece: Insulin clearance and sensitivity change in CKD and dialysis; surrogate indices checked against clamp.
LC-MS/MS sulfonylurea and meglitinide assays that make the drug-screen part of the panel usable.
UK classification algorithm accuracy in insulin-treated people without C-peptide (comparator); Japanese C-peptide indices for insulin indication.
